_doc: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for all CURRENT CashGuard-AI model metrics (SIH26184).
_rule: Every current-facing document/artifact must cite THIS file. Any figure in this repo not derivable from here is either (a) SUPERSEDED pre-leakage history, or (b) a controlled synthetic-eval detail. Do NOT restore the leaky 0.92x AUC.
evaluation_kind: CONTROLLED SYNTHETIC EVALUATION — no real-world field performance is claimed

dataset_provenance.real_world_note: All labels are synthetic; NO real NCRP/CFCFRMS/NPCI data used. See REAL_DATA_GAP.md, LABEL_PROVENANCE_FINAL.md.
dataset_provenance.leakage_fix: Same-day label leakage bug in backend/ml/features.py (_shift_day_past) fixed. The 0.92x figures were invalid and are SUPERSEDED.

leakage_safety_proof.note: Every feature timestamp < label timestamp verified; permutation tests label-shuffle AUC ~0.5; no identity columns. See artifacts/leakage_audit.json, deep_eval/permutation_tests.json.

dispatch_threshold_operating_point._note: High top-K precision but low absolute recall — disclosed, not hidden. The operational value is concentrating finite reviewer attention on 30-60 ATM/cycles at 67-75% precision, NOT national recall.

cold_district.note: district==city in this single-district synthetic world

new_hotspot.note: top-20% volume ATMs held out (180 ATMs)

generalization_current.conclusion: Time-forward and random comparable (no memorization of test window); cold-ATM degrades modestly; cold-city/district and new-hotspot generalize well on synthetic data. Failures reported, not averaged away.

baseline_superiority_current._note: CashGuard P@100=0.710 vs baselines on identical held-out test. Recomputed Sep 5 2026.

intervention_budget_war_current._note: Identical held-out synthetic test period; top-K per day per strategy; 10 seeds; 24h capture window; 5 strategies INCLUDING complaint-proximity (new). Expected value per intervention frames operational utility. RECOMPUTED authoritatively 2026-08-30; supersedes earlier 0.055/41418 figures (verified stale).
intervention_budget_war_current.disclaimer: Totals are illustrative synthetic ₹ amounts; no real-world per-ATM loss benchmark exists (see REAL_DATA_GAP.md). The value frame is decision-side concentration of attention, not an ROI claim.

honest_limitations_current: Low absolute recall at dispatch thresholds (base rate ~5%, low recall ~0.8-2% at precision 0.65-0.75). This is ranked-precision utility, NOT national recall.
Synthetic-only dataset: no real NCRP/CFCFRMS/NPCI data; field accuracy never claimed.
Cold-city/district and new-hotspot generalize worst (0.58-0.62 AUC) — the honest ceiling; novel hotspot discovery is not reliable and is reported, plus HOLD is used on low confidence.
Single-state/single-district demo world; true multi-jurisdiction requires independent jurisdictions (requires real generator/region expansion).
Scalability to national production not proven (SQLite/demo-scale only; PostgreSQL/Kafka/Redis are adapters, not load-validated).

verified_dead_ends: per-ATM spatial complaint proximity (~0.50 AUC; generator does not co-locate complaints and fraud ATMs)

issue1_model_upgrade_2026_08_31.honest_bottom_line: 0.82 is the leakage-era invalid number; genuine ceiling for this detuned synthetic task is ~0.65-0.68. Higher AUC requires real field data (REAL_DATA_GAP.md) or is dishonest.

data_fix_2026_09_05._note: CRITICAL FIX: Previous 45K-withdrawal dataset had withdrawals spanning only 40 days (Mar 9-Apr 18) while complaints spanned 179 days. Root cause: data generated in separate runs. Fixed by regenerating full 200K dataset atomically via generate_all().
